conditions.title: Terms of Use
conditions.subtitle: projet-x Platform – Gabon
conditions.intro: These Terms of Use govern access to and use of the projet-x platform, a service connecting qualified artisans and clients in Gabon. Using the platform implies full and unreserved acceptance of these Terms.

art1.title: Article 1 – Purpose
art1.body: The projet-x platform is a service connecting qualified tradespeople with individuals or professionals seeking artisan services in Gabon. It allows clients to find a tradesperson by trade type and geographic area, and allows artisans to promote their business and receive quote requests.

art2.title: Article 2 – Definitions
art2.body: Platform refers to the projet-x mobile application and all its features. Artisan refers to any registered professional offering their services through the platform. Client refers to any person seeking artisan services. Quote request refers to a solicitation sent by a client to an artisan.

art3.title: Article 3 – Registration and accounts
art3.body: Registration is open to anyone with a valid phone number. Each user is responsible for the confidentiality of their credentials and any activity carried out from their account. Accounts are strictly personal and may not be transferred or shared. In case of suspected fraud, projet-x reserves the right to suspend the account in question.

art4.title: Article 4 – Artisan profile verification
art4.body: All artisan profiles undergo manual validation by the projet-x team before becoming visible to clients. This verification may take 24 to 48 hours. projet-x reserves the right to refuse or suspend any profile that does not meet quality standards or these Terms.

art5.title: Article 5 – Subscription plans
art5.body: Artisans have access to three subscription levels: Free (up to 3 quote requests per month), Standard (up to 10 per month), and Premium (unlimited requests). Paid plans are billed at the rates displayed in the application. projet-x reserves the right to modify rates with 30 days' notice.

art6.title: Article 6 – Quote requests
art6.body: The platform facilitates contact between clients and artisans without intervening in pricing or service delivery. projet-x is not a party to contracts concluded between clients and artisans. All services are agreed directly between the parties, under their sole responsibility.

art7.title: Article 7 – Calendar and appointments
art7.body: The built-in calendar allows artisans to manage their availability and clients to view available slots. Scheduling an appointment through the platform is an arrangement between the artisan and the client, without any commitment from projet-x as to its completion.

art8.title: Article 8 – User-published content
art8.body: Photos, descriptions, and information published on the platform remain the property of their authors. By publishing them, the user grants projet-x a non-exclusive display licence. Any illegal, misleading, or harmful content will be removed without notice.

art9.title: Article 9 – User obligations
art9.body: Users agree to provide accurate and up-to-date information, to respect other users, and not to use the platform for fraudulent purposes or in violation of applicable Gabonese laws and regulations.

art10.title: Article 10 – Personal data
art10.body: projet-x collects and processes personal data (name, phone, location, photos) for account management and matchmaking. This data is not sold to third parties. You have the right to access, correct, and delete your data through the app settings or by contacting us.

art11.title: Article 11 – Limitation of liability
art11.body: projet-x acts as a technical intermediary and does not guarantee the quality of services performed by artisans. The platform shall not be held liable for disputes between a client and an artisan, or for service interruptions caused by external factors such as network outages or force majeure.

art12.title: Article 12 – Changes to Terms
art12.body: projet-x reserves the right to modify these Terms at any time. Users will be notified of any substantial change via an in-app notification. Continued use of the platform after any change constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

art13.title: Article 13 – Governing law and disputes
art13.body: These Terms are governed by Gabonese law. In case of dispute, the parties agree to seek an amicable resolution before any legal action. Failing an amicable agreement, any dispute shall be submitted to the competent courts of Libreville, Gabon.

art14.title: Article 14 – Contact
art14.body: For any questions about these Terms or the use of the platform, contact us at: contact@projet-x.app or via the support form accessible from the app settings.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: projet-x Platform – Gabon
privacy.intro: projet-x is committed to protecting the privacy of its users. This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and what rights you have over it.

art1.title: Article 1 – Data controller
art1.body: The data controller for personal data is projet-x, operating the artisan matchmaking platform in Gabon. For any questions regarding the processing of your data, you can contact us at: contact@projet-x.app.

art2.title: Article 2 – Data collected
art2.body: We collect the following data when you register and use the platform: identity information (full name), contact details (phone number), geographic location (city, work area, or GPS coordinates for artisans), portfolio photos (artisans only), professional information (trade, skills, indicative rate), and browsing data (connection logs, in-app actions).

art3.title: Article 3 – Purposes of processing
art3.body: Your data is processed for the following purposes: creating and managing your account, connecting clients and artisans, displaying artisan profiles, processing quote requests and appointments, sending notifications related to your activity on the platform, and continuous improvement of our services.

art4.title: Article 4 – Legal basis
art4.body: The processing of your data is based on the following legal grounds: performance of the usage contract you accepted upon registration, your consent for non-essential communications, and our legitimate interests in platform security and improvement.

art5.title: Article 5 – Data recipients
art5.body: Your data is accessible to projet-x teams for platform operations. Artisan profiles (name, trade, area, rate, portfolio photos) are visible to all platform users. No data is sold or transferred to third parties for commercial purposes.

art6.title: Article 6 – Hosting and security
art6.body: Your data is hosted on Supabase servers, a secure cloud service provider. We implement technical and organisational measures to protect your data against unauthorised access, loss, or disclosure, including encrypted communications (HTTPS/TLS) and access controls.

art7.title: Article 7 – Data retention
art7.body: Your data is retained for the duration of your active account on the platform. If you delete your account, your personal data is deleted within 30 days, except for data needed to fulfil our legal obligations, which is retained for the legally required period.

art8.title: Article 8 – Your rights
art8.body: Under applicable regulations, you have the following rights over your data: right of access (obtain a copy of your data), right to rectification (correct inaccurate data), right to erasure (request deletion of your data), right to portability, and right to object. To exercise these rights, contact us at: contact@projet-x.app.

art9.title: Article 9 – International transfers
art9.body: Your data may be processed by our technical service providers established outside Gabon, including Supabase. Such transfers are governed by appropriate contractual safeguards ensuring a level of protection equivalent to that in force in Gabon.

art10.title: Article 10 – Policy changes
art10.body: This Privacy Policy may be updated at any time. You will be notified of any substantial change via an in-app notification. The date of the last update is shown at the top of this document.

art11.title: Article 11 – Contact and complaints
art11.body: For any questions about this Policy or to exercise your rights, contact us at: contact@projet-x.app. For unresolved complaints, you may contact the competent data protection authority in Gabon.
